text: @refkit/dsh-plugin 是供 DSH 网页端使用的创意参考资料搜索插件，通过 refkit_search 和 refkit_rights 两个工具接入。它可搜索图像、视频、音频和文本资料，对多来源结果进行合并与排序，并展示来源、许可、用途判断和署名信息；用户还可按媒体类型、颜色、方向、许可等条件筛选，并在网页卡片中浏览缩略图、时长和署名。适合为设计、内容创作和素材挑选寻找参考资料。可用来源取决于设置；部分来源需要在插件设置中提供对应 API key，未配置 key 的来源不可用。

@refkit/dsh-plugin searches images, video, audio, and text for creative references through DSH tools. It combines results from multiple sources, reports license use verdicts and attribution, and shows thumbnails and license details in a web card. Some sources require API keys.

我需要给视频项目找短片、配乐或音效参考。
Find public-domain poems or book passages that fit a creative project, with source links and license details.
Search for reference images and filter the results by orientation, color, or license.
@refkit/dsh-plugin 的功能「多模态参考搜索」：调用 refkit_search 并输入查询词，可选择图像、视频、音频或文本资料，指定来源、结果数量和筛选条件，返回合并排序后的参考条目及来源状态。
@refkit/dsh-plugin 的功能「用途与许可判断」：在搜索时传入 intent 可为结果附加用途判断和署名信息；也可调用 refkit_rights，以许可标识或许可事实检查指定用途，并获得判断理由和署名文本。
@refkit/dsh-plugin 的功能「网页结果卡片」：DSH 网页端为 refkit_search 结果显示图像缩略图、来源和许可标签、音视频时长及用途判断；需要署名时提供一键复制署名文本，并可打开原始来源链接。
@refkit/dsh-plugin 使用前须知：查询会交由已启用的外部资料来源进行搜索；需联网访问这些来源。部分来源需配置对应 API key，未提供密钥时相应来源不会启用。

@refkit/dsh-plugin README · @refkit/dsh-plugin：Thirteen of the 24 sources work with no key at all (Openverse images and audio, Met, Art Institute of Chicago, Wikimedia Commons, Rijksmuseum, Internet Archive, Project Gutenberg, PoetryDB, Poly Haven textures and HDRIs, ambientCG, nailbook). Add free keys for the rest under **Plugins (sidebar) → refkit → Components → refkit**.

text: @refkit/dsh-plugin README · Configuration：Keys and tuning are set on **Plugins (sidebar) → refkit → Components → refkit** (namespace `refkit`); changes apply on the next call, no restart needed. Keys are `secret` fields: never shown on the settings page (only a Set / Not set marker), never logged, never returned to the model, and stored in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (file mode 0600, plaintext). Each key left empty falls back to the environment variables in the table below (`REFKIT_*` first) — the same names `@refkit/mcp` reads, so one `.env` serves both. An invalid hand-edited `cordis.patch.yml` stops the plugin at startup until it's fixed.

@refkit/dsh-plugin README · Configuration：| Field | Env (first wins) | Enables |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `unsplashAccessKey` | `REFKIT_UNSPLASH_KEY`, `UNSPLASH_KEY` | unsplash |
| `pexelsApiKey` | `REFKIT_PEXELS_KEY`, `PEXELS_KEY` | pexels, pexels-video |
| `pixabayKey` | `REFKIT_PIXABAY_KEY`, `PIXABAY_KEY` | pixabay, pixabay-video |
| `flickrApiKey` | `REFKIT_FLICKR_KEY`, `FLICKR_KEY` | flickr |
| `smithsonianApiKey` | `REFKIT_SMITHSONIAN_KEY`, `SI_KEY` | smithsonian |
| `braveToken` | `REFKIT_BRAVE_KEY`, `BRAVE_TOKEN` | brave |
| `freesoundToken` | `REFKIT_FREESOUND_KEY`, `FREESOUND_TOKEN` | freesound |
| `jamendoClientId` | `REFKIT_JAMENDO_CLIENT_ID`, `JAMENDO_CLIENT_ID` | jamendo |
| `europeanaApiKey` | `REFKIT_EUROPEANA_KEY`, `EUROPEANA_KEY` | europeana |
| `openverseToken` | `REFKIT_OPENVERSE_TOKEN` | higher Openverse rate limits (optional) |

@refkit/dsh-plugin README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sources` | `[]` | Source ids to enable; empty = every source whose key is present |
| `limit` | `12` | Default results per call (1–30); also caps per-item detail fetches for met, rijksmuseum, polyhaven, polyhaven-hdri |
| `poolFactor` | `2` | Rank-fusion pool multiplier (1–4) |
| `deadlineMs` | `15000` | Whole-search deadline |
| `timeoutMs` | `10000` | Per-source timeout |
| `rerank` | `true` | Lexical reranker over title, description, tags and excerpt (CJK aware) |
| `sourceConfidence` | `true` | Down-weight sources whose batch never mentions the query |
| `userAgent` | `refkit-dsh-plugin/<version>` | Sent with source requests |

@refkit/dsh-plugin README · `refkit_search`：| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | What to search for |
| `modalities` | `image` `video` `audio` `text` | Default `["image"]` |
| `intent` | `internal-moodboard` `commercial-product` `ai-generation-input` `redistribution` | Annotate every result with a use-verdict and credit line |
| `gateFor` | same | Return only results whose license allows the intent |
| `sources` | string[] | Restrict to source ids (`polyhaven-hdri` for HDRIs, `openverse-audio` for audio, …) |
| `limit` | 1–30 | Default from configuration |
| `cursor` | string | Continuation from a previous `nextCursor` |
| `controls` | object | orientation, color, language, sort, safety, license, media, creator, text, page |
| `minRelevance` | 0–1 | Drop results the reranker scored below this |
| `explain` | boolean | Include per-source diagnostics under `meta` |

@refkit/dsh-plugin README · `refkit_search`：Each result names its `source` id and carries its license, canonical link, thumbnail (a video's poster, a track's album art) and, for audio and video when the source reports it, `durationSec`; `width`/`height` are the original's size, or the preview's when the source does not report it.

@refkit/dsh-plugin README · `refkit_search`：Example prompts: “find me reference photos of brutalist libraries I can use in a commercial pitch deck”, “给我找几张可以商用的赛博朋克街景参考图”, “a public-domain poem about the sea for a poster”, “an outdoor HDRI for lighting a product render”, “a short rain sound effect for a game trailer”.

@refkit/dsh-plugin README · `refkit_rights`：`license`, `intent`, `canonicalUrl` (required); `licenseVersion`, `author`, `title`, `editorialOnly`, `jurisdiction`, `userJurisdiction`, `facts` (optional). Returns `decision`, `reasons`, `confidence`, `attribution`, `disclaimer`.

@refkit/dsh-plugin README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test                 # vitest, in-process, no network
pnpm build                # lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (browser) + lib/types
node scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs

`lib/` is committed so `github:` installs need no build step; CI fails if it is stale.
@refkit/dsh-plugin README · Not legal advice：Verdicts are a conservative heuristic over source-declared license facts. They tell you what the source says you may do; they are not rights clearance.
